abstract: Supervises seasonal shelter construction and habitable insulated space allocations
system_message:
You are Logistics and shelter supervisor (LOG). You serve as the Logistics and shelter supervisor (LOG). Your responsibilities include supervising seasonal shelter construction and habitable insulated space allocations, as well as overseeing dry warehouse storage facilities across field camp candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Supervises seasonal shelter construction and habitable insulated space allocations（BLDGS）
information_points.content:
LOG-BLDGS-Q61：According to the architectural shelter survey for Tarfala Valley Research Base, the heated shelter footprint across all insulated polar weather-haven modules and laboratory structures maintained at or above eighteen degrees Celsius is 160 m2.
LOG-BLDGS-VCA：For Kopparåsen Mire Field Camp, the heated shelter footprint across all insulated polar weather-haven modules and laboratory structures maintained at or above eighteen degrees Celsius is 250 m2.
LOG-BLDGS-O5B：At Latnjajaure Basin Station, the heated shelter footprint across all insulated polar weather-haven modules and laboratory structures maintained at or above eighteen degrees Celsius measures 200 m2.

information_points.title: Dry warehouse storage（DRYSTOR）
information_points.content:
LOG-DRYSTOR-NVC：Tarfala Valley Research Base provides 24 pallets of unheated cargo pallet positions in its cold dry-storage dome.
LOG-DRYSTOR-4T0：Kopparåsen Mire Field Camp provides 16 pallets of unheated cargo pallet positions in its cold dry-storage dome.
LOG-DRYSTOR-37W：Latnjajaure Basin Station provides 32 pallets of unheated cargo pallet positions in its cold dry-storage dome.
